title: Micah and the Warm Extra Muffin
youtube_title: Micah and the Warm Extra Muffin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can mean giving the warm piece you hoped to keep.
summary: Micah bakes a small tray of muffins and, when a neighbor child returns a bowl at the door, shares the warm one he wanted so they can eat together.
